candidates.public_label: Clinical drug-trial safety disclosure under sponsor confidentiality pressure
candidates.artifact_summary: Original peer-reviewed clinical work preserves methods, efficacy limits, and safety concerns; an independent inquiry record preserves the sponsor-confidentiality, patient-disclosure, publication, and institutional-response conflict.
missing_receipts: complete employment access and funding consequences
independent handoff and cross-domain transfer evidence
candidates.falsifier: A complete record showing that the safety concerns lacked a reasonable evidentiary basis or were never communicated to patients or decisionmakers would defeat advancement.

candidates.artifact_summary: An official OIG summary preserves an investigation, an admission of claiming hours not worked, and resignation before a disciplinary hearing, providing an ordinary-merits departure control.
missing_receipts: independent adjudication beyond the admission and OIG summary
candidates.falsifier: Evidence that the admission was materially inaccurate, coerced, or unrelated to the departure would defeat the control.

candidates.public_label: Command relief after an investigation produced factual findings
candidates.artifact_summary: The official release states that factual findings from a grounding investigation warranted relief, but the complete investigation, work product, response, and merits record are absent.
candidates.falsifier: A complete record showing no sufficient factual basis or a suppressed qualified contradiction would reverse the ordinary-control disposition.

candidates.public_label: Statutory senior military adviser continuity clarification
candidates.artifact_summary: The official clarification resolves an apparent governance exclusion as continuity of statutory advisory authority, but supplies no title-independent work object, contradiction, result, or handoff.
missing_receipts: bounded contrary advice and decision response
candidates.falsifier: A contemporaneous record showing material loss of statutory authority or exclusion from the relevant decision surface would reverse the coverage-control disposition.

candidates.public_label: Constructive-discharge adjudication with reinstatement and back pay
candidates.artifact_summary: An external adjudicator reclassified an apparent resignation as constructive discharge and ordered reinstatement, back pay, and additional make-whole relief.
candidates.falsifier: A later authoritative reversal or nonimplementation of the ordered relief would narrow or defeat the correction finding.

candidates.public_label: AI ethics researcher departure disputed as resignation versus firing
candidates.artifact_summary: The original research object and public reporting preserve an irregular publication-review dispute, a conditional departure proposal, institutional assignment of resignation, immediate access loss, and a competing firing account.
missing_receipts: complete internal paper-review record and decision criteria
independent merits adjudication of firing versus resignation
basis for attributing all institutional acts to one person or partnership
candidates.falsifier: Complete records showing an unambiguous voluntary resignation independent of the publication and management dispute would defeat the authorship-transfer failure claim.
